pin_diameter.interpretation: SNL56:3/16-inch steel pin; no nominal fit specified.

pin_length.interpretation: SNL56:2-1/2-inch steel pin, one per cap assembly.

axis_from_cup_back.interpretation: Hinge axis near the rear edge of the oil-cup cover, consistent with HB20 Plate11.

axis_above_lid.interpretation: Estimated knuckle center above closed lid underside.

knuckle_radius.interpretation: Estimated integral hinge boss radius; no source diameter.

lid_knuckle_half_length.interpretation: Estimated central lid knuckle extent along shaft axis.

cap_knuckle_length.interpretation: Estimated width of each of two integral cap lugs.

axial_knuckle_gap.interpretation: Nominal display clearance between interleaved hinge segments; not a manufacturing tolerance.

pin_radial_gap.interpretation: Unthreaded hinge bore radial display allowance.

pedestal_embed.interpretation: Depth tying integral cap lug pedestals into existing cup rear wall.

radial_witness_shift.interpretation: Diagnostic displacement to prove pin is constrained by the bore walls.

identity: Four physical pins. Knuckles are features of M294/M298 caps and M295 covers, not new catalogue parts.
deferred: Pin axial retention or interference fit is undocumented.
